section.description: From complete privacy to self-guided game drives and outdoor cooking under the stars. Discover what makes Farm Elkana unique.

heading: Experiences at
Farm Elkana
hero.subheading: Discover the untamed beauty of Namibia through our curated adventures and cultural encounters.

items.title: Absolute Privacy
items.name: Absolute Privacy
items.description: Farm Elkana offers an exclusive, private retreat where you and your group are the only guests. No shared spaces, no strangers — just you, the wilderness, and complete tranquility. Every corner of the lodge is yours to enjoy at your own pace.
highlights: Exclusive use of the entire property
No other guests during your stay
Private pool, lounge, and outdoor areas
Personalized schedule — no fixed meal times

items.title: DIY Game Drives
items.name: DIY Game Drives
items.description: Take the wheel and explore the reserve at your own pace. Our self-guided game drive routes wind through diverse habitats where you can spot a variety of Namibian wildlife. Maps, tips, and binoculars provided — the adventure is yours to shape.
highlights: Spot oryx, kudu, springbok, and more
Drive at sunrise or sunset for the best sightings

items.title: Braai & Pizza Nights
items.name: Braai & Pizza Nights
items.description: Experience the heart of Namibian hospitality with our outdoor braai and wood-fired pizza setup. Gather around the fire pit under a canopy of stars, grill your own cuts, and enjoy freshly baked pizza straight from the oven — a true farm-to-table experience.
highlights: Premium local cuts and fresh ingredients
